label: Fourier embedding of the noise level

spec.title: How the noise level enters the AF3 denoiser (SI Algorithms 21 and 22)
spec.caption: 256 random Fourier features, frozen before training. The derivation of the similarity uses w, b ~ N(0, 1); with 256 features the empirical similarity scatters by about ±0.06 around it.
spec.main_latex: s_i \leftarrow s_i + W\,\mathrm{LN}\big(\cos(2\pi(u\,w + b))\big), \qquad u = \tfrac14 \ln(\hat t/\sigma_\text{data})

steps.explanation: Put the noise level on a log scale centred on σ_data. The whole schedule, 2560 Å down to 0.0064 Å, a factor of 400,000, becomes a short interval of length 3.2. This is EDM's c_noise.

steps.latex: w, b \sim \mathcal N(0, I_{256}), \text{ drawn once and frozen}
steps.explanation: 256 random frequencies and phases. They are never trained; only the layers after them are.
Each feature is a wave in u. Small |w_k| gives a slow wave that separates high from low noise; large |w_k| gives fast waves that separate neighbouring noise levels.
Product to sum. The second term averages out over the random phases (its expectation carries a factor e^{-8π²} ≈ 10⁻³⁴).

steps.latex: \mathbb E_w\big[\cos(2\pi w\,\Delta)\big] = e^{-2\pi^2 \Delta^2} \;\Rightarrow\; \frac{n(u)^\top n(u')}{\|n(u)\|\,\|n(u')\|} \approx e^{-2\pi^2 (u - u')^2}
steps.explanation: The average of a cosine over Gaussian frequencies is the Gaussian's characteristic function: the code's similarity is a Gaussian kernel in u.

steps.latex: \sigma' = r\,\sigma: \quad \text{similarity} \approx e^{-\pi^2 (\ln r)^2 / 8} = 0.5 \text{ at } r \approx 2.1,\ < 0.01 \text{ at } r = 10
steps.explanation: In noise-level units: two levels a factor of two apart get half-similar codes, a factor of ten apart nearly unrelated ones. The network can treat about a dozen noise regimes along the schedule differently, without being told any boundaries.

steps.latex: s_i \leftarrow s_i + W\,\mathrm{LN}(n), \quad \text{then } \mathrm{AdaLN}(a, s) \text{ in all 24 token blocks}
steps.explanation: The code is added to every token's single conditioning, and through adaptive LayerNorm it sets the scale, shift and gates of every layer: one network, told at every step which regime it is in.
